freeze_requirements: At least 100 records are adjudicated as eligible canonical positives.
Positive records cover the design families actually supported by eligible literature.
Targeted supplemental searches have been completed for unrepresented prespecified design families.
Fifty records from each available database query branch have completed manual relevance review.
Every canonical positive is retrievable in each database that indexes it, or the database-specific miss is documented.
interpretation: The 120-record candidate pool is an algorithmically prioritized expert-review queue, not a gold standard and not 120 confirmed eligible studies.
